2585-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2585-4659-5660-6769.description:
Cast Grim Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Grim Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Grim Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Grim Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

1395-5078-7730-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska and Elsha's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve the Elsha trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn
Resolve the Vraska trigger, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

728-1339-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-7920.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

628-6495-7188.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7188.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4365-6441-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3525-6006-7938.description:
Activate Shuttle Ace by tapping it, adding {U}.
Shuttle Ace triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Shuttle Ace.
Repeat.

880-4871-7889.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-4871-7889.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Perilous Forays ability, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1308-7824-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Anointed Procession and Bard.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
1308-7824-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1368-3755-6321-7175.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-6321-7175.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3375-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3234-3293-5226-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5226-6798.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5226-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4616-4809-5220.description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Shifting Wall from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

4779-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5500-6791.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-6791.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2511-4484-4871-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-4484-4871-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2060-3716-4613-6652.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by paying {6}{R}{R}.
Ultros's first and second abilities trigger, tapping a creature an opponent controls and putting a stun counter on it, and then putting eight +1/+1 counters on Ultros.
Resolve Fanning the Flames, dealing 3 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Activate Ultros using Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counter from it, adding {6}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

224-1032-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Power of Fire attached to Avenging Druid.
224-1032-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

238-1365-1477-5231.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-5231.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Gerrard, adding {R}.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

455-4067-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 8 or greater.
455-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least eight {U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying {6}{U}{U}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
455-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

1367-1982-4128.notablePrerequisites:
You have not cast a creature spell using Chainer this turn.
You have at least one card in hand.
1367-1982-4128.description:
Activate Chainer by discarding a card, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sidisi from your graveyard by paying {3}{B}{B}.
When Sidisi enters the battlefield, its exploit ability and Chainer trigger.
Resolve the Chainer trigger, giving Sidisi haste until end of turn.
Resolve the Sidisi trigger, causing you to sacrifice Sidisi.
Sidisi's second ability triggers, causing you to search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

2034-2510-3874-5222.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of the Realms attached to Armory Automaton.
Any artifact or creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.
2034-2510-3874-5222.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Armory Automaton, adding {C}{C}.
Armory Automaton dies, triggering Sword of the Realms, returning Armory Automaton from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Armory Automaton by paying {1}.
Armory Automaton enters the battlefield, attaching Sword of the Realms to it.
Repeat.

1183-1636-2757.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
The Pentavite enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.
